name: Arad
overview: The name Arad appears in Scripture both as a Canaanite city and as a personal name. The city of Arad, located in the southern region of Canaan, was ruled by a king who opposed Israel as they journeyed toward the Promised Land, taking some Israelites captive (Numbers 21:1, 33:40). This king of Arad was later subdued during the conquest under Joshua's leadership, demonstrating God's sovereign hand in Israel's victory over the Canaanite kings (Joshua 12:14). Additionally, Arad is noted as a son of Beriah, showing the name's use beyond geography.
